title: Waste of money
text: So disappointed in this.  I ordered for a friend for Christmas and sadly I will not be giving it to her.  Seriously, not even 4 or 5 dollar store items with red and green shredded paper around it.  There was a rolling pin ornament that was so poorly made it was hard to even know what it was. The paper around the pin was so wrinkled I thought it was a pin shaped chocolate, but no, just poor sweat shop work.  I would be embarrassed to gift it.  Going to try to return this 39.00 box of junk.
label: negative
